cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, has been up on Mount Sinai with God (Exodus 31:18), and he's delayed in coming down. So the people gather around Aaron, Moses' brother, and say, "Come, make us gods who will go before us." They say they don't know what's happened to Moses, like when the tracking says your package is "arriving today" and by dinner the whole house has declared it gone FOREVER.

cards.question: Aaron tells the people to take something off their wives and sons and daughters and bring it to him. What is it?

cards.text: All the people take off their earrings and bring them to Aaron. He takes the gold from their hands, picks up an engraving tool and gets to work.

cards.question: Aaron takes the people's gold and fashions it into a molten ___.

cards.text: Then the people say, "These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!" Friend, that's like me stamping a cookie this morning and then thanking it for pulling me out of the junk drawer I sat in for years.

cards.question: Next, Aaron builds ___ in front of the calf.

cards.text: Then Aaron proclaims: "Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD." So the next day they get up and offer burnt offerings and peace offerings.

cards.question: After the burnt offerings and peace offerings, the people sit down to eat and drink and get up to indulge in revelry.

cards.text: Then, up on the mountain, the LORD speaks to Moses. He says, "Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves."

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses the people have turned aside from the way He commanded them. How does He say they turned aside?

cards.text: The LORD also says He has seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people. Friend, I know stiff: I've leaned my whole gold base into cold dough that would NOT take a stamp.
Then the LORD says, "Now leave Me alone, so that My anger may burn against them and consume them. Then I will make you into a great nation."

cards.question: When the LORD says, "Now leave Me alone," Moses stays quiet.
Moses asks the LORD why His anger should burn against His people. What does Moses say the Egyptians would declare?

answers.text: He brought them out to kill them in the mountains
Their own gods had beaten the God of Israel
Moses tricked the people into leaving Egypt

cards.question: Moses asks the LORD to remember His servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, also called Jacob (Genesis 32:28), the people's forefathers. What does Moses remind the LORD He swore to them?

answers.text: Descendants like the stars and the land
A temple on this very mountain

cards.question: After Moses pleads, the LORD relents from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.

cards.text: Moses turns and heads down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, inscribed on both sides, front and back. Friend, these tablets are the work of God, and the writing is the writing of God, engraved right on them.

cards.question: On the way down, Joshua, Moses' assistant, hears the people shouting and tells Moses, "The sound of war is in the camp." What does Moses say he hears?

cards.text: Moses gets close enough to SEE it: the calf, and the dancing. And Moses burns with anger.

cards.question: Moses hands the tablets to Joshua for safekeeping.
Moses throws the tablets, and they shatter at the base of the mountain. Then he burns the calf, grinds it to powder, scatters it over the water and makes the Israelites ___ it.

cards.text: Then Moses turns to Aaron, and friend, I would NOT want to be in Aaron's apron right now. Moses asks what this people did to him that he has led them into so great a sin.

cards.question: Aaron tells Moses not to be enraged. He says Moses himself knows the people are intent on ___.
Aaron repeats what the people asked for. Then he tells Moses he fashioned the calf himself with an engraving tool.

cards.text: Here's Aaron's side of it: "And when I threw it into the fire, out came this calf!" Friend, that's like me telling Mother Miller, the lady who took me home for a quarter, that the dough hopped under me and stamped ITSELF.
Moses sees the people are out of control, for Aaron had let them run wild, and they've become a laughingstock to their enemies.

cards.question: Moses stands at the entrance to the camp and calls out, "Whoever is for the LORD, come to me." Who gathers around him?

cards.text: This next part is heavy, friend. Moses gives them a command from the LORD, the God of Israel: each man is to fasten his sword to his side, go through the camp from gate to gate, and slay his brother, his friend and his neighbor.
The Levites do as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fall dead. Afterward, Moses tells the Levites they've been ordained for service to the LORD today.

cards.question: Moses tells the Levites that the LORD has bestowed a blessing on them this day.

cards.text: The next day Moses tells the people they've committed a great sin. Now he'll go up to the LORD, and perhaps he can make atonement for their sin.

cards.question: Moses goes back to the LORD and asks Him to forgive the people's sin. But if not, what does Moses ask for?

answers.text: To be blotted out of God's book
To be released from leading them
To be given a new people to lead

cards.question: The LORD replies that whoever has ___ against Him, He will blot out of His book.
The LORD tells Moses to stay on the mountain while the people wait at the camp.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "Behold, My angel shall go before you." But on the day He settles accounts, He will punish the people for their sin.
And the LORD sends a plague on the people because of what they did with the calf Aaron made. We'll pause the oven right there, friend, because this story isn't over.
